observations: Torah #184 has zero bechina edges in torahData.js and therefore no algorithmically derived packages can be formed. The framework requires actual bechina edges from the dataset as the structural basis for packages — source text alone is insufficient. That said, the source text does contain a coherent cluster of concepts that, once encoded as bechina edges, would naturally form one package: the Kabbalistic light-physics cluster of אור חוזר / הכאה / דיבור לחבר / התעוררות. The text explicitly calls haka'ah the 'bechina' of or chozer, making this a genuine parallel-essence relationship rather than a cause-and-effect chain. A second smaller cluster would be אור ישר / קבלה מחבר (direct light / receiving from a friend). However, as of this analysis, neither cluster has the three or more bechina edges required to propose a new package under the algorithm. If reference-184 edges are ever added to torahData.js, a single good-polarity package centered on 'אור חוזר וְהַכָּאָה — Reflected Light and Impact' should be the primary package candidate, with 'אור ישר' likely forming a second related package or merging in depending on how many edges are added.
